# TOKI SATSUEI

> Small photography team based in Quezon City, Philippines, offering cosplay photography, individual portraits, duo and group shoots, outdoor sessions, and event coverage.

## Canonical Pages
- Home & Session Rates: https://legioniz.github.io/toki-satsuei/
- Booking Request: https://legioniz.github.io/toki-satsuei/booking.html
- Photo Archive: https://legioniz.github.io/toki-satsuei/library.html
- Booking, Payment & Photo Consent Policies: https://legioniz.github.io/toki-satsuei/policies.html

## Published Session Packages (PHP)
- Quick Snap: ₱200, 15 minutes, 3 edited photos, selected unedited JPEGs, 1 character or outfit
- Toki Portraits: ₱350, 30 minutes, 6 edited photos, selected unedited JPEGs, multiple poses and compositions
- Signature Session: ₱500, 60 minutes, 10 edited photos, selected unedited JPEGs, more creative poses
- Duo Session: ₱450, 30 minutes, up to 2 cosplayers, 6 edited photos, selected unedited JPEGs
- Add-ons: Additional edited photo ₱30, additional 15 minutes ₱75, additional participant ₱50
- Outdoor, event, and custom coverage: duration and pricing agreed in writing before confirmation

## Key Policies
- Location: Transportation within Quezon City is included; travel outside Quezon City is discussed before confirmation.
- Delivery: Edited photographs and selected unedited JPEGs are delivered through a private online gallery link within 7 days after the session.
- Booking confirmation: A submitted form is an inquiry, not a reservation. Paid sessions require a 20% reservation fee (credited toward the total) after written agreement on schedule and final price.
- Client consent: Client photographs are added to the public portfolio only with explicit permission from the people featured (or a parent/guardian for minors).
